paras: Application: Nissan GT-R | R35 | VR38DETT 3.8L Twin-Turbo V6 | Manual Transmission

The R35 GT-R is one of the most technically sophisticated performance cars ever built — a twin-turbocharged VR38DETT V6 producing serious power, a sophisticated AWD system, and a chassis engineered to lap circuits at supercar pace. The VR38 generates enormous heat under sustained high-load driving, and with GT-Rs increasingly being used on track and in high-power builds, a quality cooling upgrade is essential to protecting the engine and maintaining consistent performance.
hl: Precise Tube & Fin Alignment — Optimal coolant flow and maximum heat transfer efficiency.
